source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]

    colors = set(v for _, _, v in interior)
    def bounds(color):
        pts = [(r, c) for r, c, v in interior if v == color]
        return min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts), min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)

    a, b, x, y = bounds(fill) if colors else (r0, r1, c0, c1)
    ih, iw = b-a+1, y-x+1
    margin = min(ih, iw) if ih == iw else max(1, min(ih, iw)-1)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0 - margin), min(h, r1 + margin + 1)):
